verification: DEPRECATED after on-car field test: ignition cut did nothing. Root cause confirmed in the stock disassembly: file 0x39630 is a one-time CAN/PEC message-object initialization dispatcher, not a recurring ignition-output hook. The old emulator gate started directly at the splice and therefore proved cave logic but not reachability. Superseded by ignition_cut_v7 at the proven P1L.0..5 final-stage charge commands.
title: Ignition Cut
description: DEPRECATED and remove-only. On-car testing confirmed no spark cut because the splice at file 0x39630 belongs to CAN/PEC initialization and does not execute in the recurring ignition path. Retained only so already-flashed V5 images on MS41.2/MS41.3 can be detected and safely reverted before installing Ignition Cut V7.
label: V5
